summary.plain: UA2 reported eight Z0 → e+e− candidate events giving a Z mass of 91.9 ± 1.3 (stat) ± 1.4 (syst) GeV/c². The paper is titled 'Evidence for Z0 → e+e−', a more cautious word than the 'Observation' in UA1's title.
summary.technical: UA2 Collaboration, Phys. Lett. B 129 (1983) 130-140: eight Z0 → e+e− candidate events giving a Z boson mass of 91.9 ± 1.3 (stat) ± 1.4 (syst) GeV/c². The title says 'Evidence for' where UA1's Z paper says 'Observation of'.

title: Evidence for Z0 -> e+ e- at the CERN anti-p p Collider
why_it_matters: A second CERN collider experiment's measurement of the Z0 mass from eight Z0 → e+e− candidate events, 91.9 ± 1.3 (stat) ± 1.4 (syst) GeV/c², published in the same year as UA1's Z paper.
